questions.text: Find the expression for the Lorentz force among the following.
A particle with a charge of 0.2 C entered a magnetic field of induction 20 T at a speed of 25 m/s at an angle of $53^\circ$ to the induction lines. Find the Lorentz force acting on it (N).

What is the magnitude of the force acting on an electron that entered a uniform magnetic field of induction 4 T at a speed of $10^7$ m/s perpendicular to the induction lines (N)? $e = -1.6 \cdot 10^{-19}$ C.
What force acts on a proton moving in a magnetic field of induction 0.2 T perpendicular to the induction lines at a speed of 10 Mm/s (pN)? $e = 1.6 \cdot 10^{-19}$ C.
The Lorentz force acting on a charge of 0.4 C moving at 2 km/s perpendicular to the magnetic field lines is 8 N. What is the magnetic induction?

An electron entered a magnetic field of induction 0.2 T perpendicular to the induction lines. If the force acting on it is $0.32 \cdot 10^{-12}$ N, what is its speed (m/s)? $e = 1.6 \cdot 10^{-19}$ C.
How does the Lorentz force exerted on a proton by a magnetic field change if the proton's speed decreases 24 times and the magnetic induction increases 12 times?

Which of the directions shown in the diagram coincides with the direction of the Lorentz force acting on a moving negatively charged particle in a magnetic field? The magnetic field lines are perpendicular to the plane of the diagram, directed away from us.

Determine the direction of the Lorentz force exerted by the magnetic field on a moving positively charged particle. The magnetic induction vector of the field is perpendicular to the plane of the diagram and directed into the page, away from us ($\otimes$).
An electron enters a uniform magnetic field as shown in the figure. In which direction is the force exerted on it by the magnetic field directed?
With speed $v$, a charge $q$ entered a magnetic field of induction $B$ perpendicular to the field lines. Which expression can be used to calculate the radius of curvature of this charge's trajectory?
An ion with speed $v$ and charge $q$ enters a uniform magnetic field of induction $B$ and describes a circle of radius $R$. Which expression gives the mass of the ion?

A particle of mass 0.08 g and charge 0.002 C entered a magnetic field of induction 20 T at a speed of 25 m/s perpendicular to the induction lines. Find the radius of its circular path (cm) and its period of revolution (ms).

An electron entered a uniform magnetic field of induction 9.1 mT perpendicular to the induction lines at a speed of 16 Mm/s. Find the radius of curvature of its trajectory (cm). $m = 9.1 \cdot 10^{-31}$ kg, $e = 1.6 \cdot 10^{-19}$ C.
An electron entered a magnetic field of induction 5 mT and began to move along a circle of radius 4 cm. What is its speed (m/s)?
A proton traced a circle of radius 5 cm in a uniform magnetic field of induction 20 mT. If the proton's charge is $1.6 \cdot 10^{-19}$ C, determine its momentum (kg$\cdot$m/s).

Two particles with the same charge and the same speed entered a magnetic field perpendicular to the field lines and began to move along trajectories whose radii of curvature are related by $R_2 = 3R_1$. What is the ratio of the mass of particle 2, $m_2$, to the mass of particle 1, $m_1$, that is, $m_2/m_1$?
A particle of mass $m$ and charge $q$ moves along a circle in a uniform magnetic field of induction $B$. Find the period of revolution.

If the period of revolution of an electron in a uniform magnetic field is 9 ns, what is the magnetic induction (in mT)? The electron's charge is $1.6 \cdot 10^{-19}$ C, its mass is $9.1 \cdot 10^{-31}$ kg.

A proton that entered a uniform magnetic field of induction 16.7 mT perpendicular to the induction lines moves along a circular path. Find the number of revolutions of the proton in 3.14 s. $e = 1.6 \cdot 10^{-19}$ C, $m_p = 1.67 \cdot 10^{-27}$ kg.
A proton that entered a uniform magnetic field of magnetic induction 16.7 mT perpendicular to the induction lines moves along a circular path. How many revolutions does the proton make in $6\pi$ s?
